native_timing_scopes.cow_generation_seconds: Python RealBranchingModel.run_greedy_request starts generation timer after suffix consume and immediately before backend.generate_request; timer ends after request iterator exits. Includes native generate loop and consumed-token protocol/ack traffic plus Python iterator work; excludes suffix consume/prefill and later save/capture/publication.
native_timing_scopes.cow_request_seconds: RealBranchingModel.run_greedy_request wall from before authorize/history/materialize through saved snapshot publication; it is not the audited durable-completion wall.
native_timing_scopes.decode_compute_ns: Generated branch_driver times forward.run + forward.commit + forward.copy_logits for each generated token. Does not include begin/finish or per-token pipe/ack round trips.
native_timing_scopes.decode_finish_ns: Generated branch_driver times BranchSession.finish for each generated token.
native_timing_scopes.decode_prepare_ns: Generated branch_driver normal-verifier `generate` loop times BranchSession.begin(position,1) only. BranchSession.begin calls prepare_writes; all-pool current-page seal verification occurs in this phase before COW tail detach.
native_timing_scopes.integrity_seal_compare_ns: Nested timer around device hash/compare kernel launch through cudaDeviceSynchronize in BranchDigestWorkspace.compare_pages_view. It is included inside decode_prepare_ns for this path; do not add it to prepare or compute.
native_timing_scopes.overlap_warning: Stage counters are nested: seal compare is inside prepare; stage totals and nested seal time must not be summed. The native fresh-oracle and COW generation timers have different work boundaries.
native_timing_scopes.reference_decode_seconds: Fresh oracle timer covers greedy argmax, normal Verifier.run/commit/copy_logits loop, writing each full frontier to reference .decode.f32 and closing that trace. It has no BranchSession COW seal validation or per-token Python consumed/ack protocol.
native_timing_scopes.reference_trace_bytes_per_128: 128 * 248320 float32 logits * 4 = 127139840 bytes; retained .decode.f32 files are approximately 122 MiB and this trace write is inside reference decode_seconds.

limits: Nested integrity comparisons must not be added to decode_prepare_ns
integrity counters are whole-request deltas; normalization by generation_seconds is approximate until non-generation contribution is separately bounded
Fresh oracle decode_seconds includes roughly122MiB frontier output and lacks COW guard/ack work; it is not a matched wall-time baseline
The user8percent overhead preference is informational; a matching-baseline regression percentage is not established
